title: Move the required lore check gate to lore 0.9.0 and re-export the committed schemas in the same change
description: Routed by opum-agent under OPAG-326 after lore 0.9.0 (LCLI-565) shipped: committed schemas now carry a generator stamp (profileDigest), and lore check gains exit 7 (indeterminate) for a schema it cannot attribute. Measured here before filing, npx @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 check on dev b28bb33: exit 6, 8 errors -- 7 committed schemas schema-drift (stale stamp) plus arc.schema.json missing, because the 0.9.0 profile declares an arc type this repository has no schema for. No exit 7. A pin-only change goes red, so the pin and the export ride together. Precedent: QCLI-356 (0.7.0 to 0.8.0).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The lore-check workflow installs @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 and the bump PR own lore check run is green under it, citing the run id
The committed schemas are regenerated by lore 0.9.0 schema export in the same PR as the pin, with no schema deleted, and npx @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 check exits 0 locally

A drift-arm PR branched on top of the bump goes red with exactly one schema-drift error from lore check, asserted from the job log, with source-gates and Tracker integrity green on that SHA; closed unmerged
The resolution records the lore and quest versions it was measured against

implementationNotes: Measured before and after, lore via npx @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 (global stays 0.8.0), quest 0.9.0. Before, on dev b28bb33: 0.9.0 check exit 6, 8 schema-drift errors (7 stale stamps + arc.schema.json missing). No exit 7. After lore schema export: 8 schemas written, 0 deleted; diff is the x-lore-generator profileDigest stamp on all 7, the new arc.schema.json, and story.schema.json type widening from const Story to enum [Arc, Story]. Regenerated tree: 0.9.0 check exit 0 AND 0.8.0 check exit 0, 63 files, 0 errors. Because the old pin also passes, pin and export ride in one PR as OPAG-326 directs; the workflow comment that mandated two separate commits (from QCLI-356) is corrected to state the invariant and when each order applies.
finalSummary:
Moved the required lore check gate from lore 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 (PR #236), with the committed schemas re-exported by 0.9.0 in the same PR, as routed by opum-agent under OPAG-326 after LCLI-565.

Measured with npx @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 (the global binary stays 0.8.0):
- On dev b28bb33, 0.9.0 check exited 6 with 8 schema-drift errors: 7 stale generator stamps plus a missing arc.schema.json, because the 0.9.0 profile declares an arc type. There was no exit 7.
- After schema export, 8 schemas were written and 0 deleted. The diff adds the x-lore-generator profileDigest stamp to all 7 schemas, adds arc.schema.json, and widens story.schema.json type from const Story to enum [Arc, Story].
- The regenerated tree exits 0 under 0.9.0 AND 0.8.0 (63 files, 0 errors).

The workflow comment from QCLI-356 said a bump must be two separate commits. That no longer matched this PR, so it was corrected. It now states the invariant (the pin never moves without a regeneration by that lore) and when each order applies: one PR when the old pin also passes, two steps otherwise.

CI proof, two separate runs on two separate commits:
- Clean arm, PR #236 head 5b97e65: lore check run 35796008224 installed @opum-ai/lore@0.9.0 and passed, 63 files, 0 errors. source-gates and Tracker integrity also passed.
- Drift arm, PR #237 head 76281e0, stacked on the bump with a bogus property in adr.schema.json: lore check run 35796063614 installed 0.9.0 and failed with exit 6, exactly 1 error, adr.schema.json [schema-drift]. That was read from the job log, not the colour. source-gates and Tracker integrity passed on that SHA. PR #237 was closed unmerged and its branch deleted.

Versions: lore 0.9.0 (CI and npx), global lore 0.8.0, quest 0.9.0.
